label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 18
title: MVP: depict backend configs + script parameters (inputs/outputs) and control operations in the UI
body: Every backend config (model tiers incl. per-project overrides, capacity, agent hierarchy/requirements, test matrix, feature flags, integrations, targets, tech stack, discovery panel settings) and every entrypoint (scripts/pipeline.py subcommands; run_pipeline.py flags --tier/--only-stage/--from-stage/--control/--interactive/--step; run_portfolio.py; approve.py; core.interactive) must be depicted in the dashboard with the parameters they accept and the inputs/outputs they produce, plus operable control operations for agents and the pipeline itself (start/stop/pause/resume/retry/abort/run-agent/invalidate).
_note: see BI-0027 for the E2E workflow + full CLI parameter orchestration mapping
